_about: Engine settings. Hand edited only: the Coach never writes here. Its bounded knobs live in tunables.json, and the rules it cannot touch live in policy.json.

schedule._daily_note: Low traffic hour for the site's main markets. Deploys only happen inside deploy_window.

autopilot._note: Tiers: T0 read only, T1 reversible content metadata, T2 site configuration, T3 code deploy. Tiers listed in approval_required wait for a human; an empty list means fully hands free.

models._note: One model keeps one prompt cache. Effort is set per role; Opus 5.5 defaults to medium, so every role states it explicitly.

run_budget._note: Per run. Generation stops when either is exceeded; cache reads count at 10%.

crawl._interval_note: Never burst the site. A 2026 incident: repeated crawls from one IP put it on the host's reputation firewall.
